workload: same-source held-out document vectors as queries
qps_definition: 10000/(overall native finish - window 10 native start), window observations included
cpu_definition: full steady native process CPU delta includes observer CPU; controller compact.effective_cpu uses only window CPU
cache_definition: Ready/(Ready+Pending); Pending includes new, merged and already-completed pending handles
io_definition: 1024-byte I/O/cache blocks; mincore OS pages remain 4096 bytes
diagnostics_definition: diagnostic runs are separate; summed concurrent waiting is not an additive wall-time fraction; SQ-to-CQE includes user-space collection delay
quality_definition: engineering and full64 outputs bit-equal to parent; candidate subsets checked on common-ID bits and full64 cutoff, then independently evaluated against the same held-out FP64 truth
rss_definition: family RSS+hugetlb samples fully contained in steady interval, includes 61440000-byte query batch; mean/max/count and session peak separated
